title: Jalapeño & Roasted Red Pepper Mac'n'Cheese
description: A creamy stovetop macaroni cheese studded with pickled jalapeños and roasted red peppers, topped with melted Cheddar and served with a herby cherry tomato salad.
ingredients: 2 roasted red peppers in brine (about 160g), drained and finely sliced
Cherry tomato salad: 500g cherry tomatoes (halved), ½ red onion (finely chopped), 2 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1 tsp dried oregano, salt
steps: Place macaroni in saucepan; cover with milk and water. Add garlic and onion granules; bring to boil with lid on.
Remove lid; rapid simmer for 12 minutes, stirring occasionally. Preheat grill to highest setting.
Add jalapeños, red peppers and two-thirds of the cheese; season and stir.
Decant into ovenproof dish; scatter remaining cheese; sprinkle with smoked paprika.
Make tomato salad: mix halved cherry tomatoes with onion, vinegar, oregano and salt.
Grill mac'n'cheese for 4–5 minutes until bubbling and starting to brown. Serve with the salad.
notes: Easy to scale up. Also works as a side dish for a Mexican or Tex-Mex feast.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
